diagram_math_checks.justification: The upper row is precisely the statement hypothesis 0 -> U --i--> V --p--> W -> 0 over R. The lower row is 0 -> U_C --i_C--> V_C --p_C--> W_C -> 0 over C, with domains/codomains as in def-complexification-of-a-real-linear-map and the statement. Comparing rows uses underlying real vector spaces, explicitly stated; the vertical maps are real-linear embeddings, not asserted complex-linear or isomorphisms.

For X = U, V, W, iota_X(x)=1 tensor x, equivalently x+i0 in the direct-sum model. The embedding is the map in def-complexification-of-a-real-vector-space and L1 of thm-tensor-and-direct-sum-models-of-complexification-agree; the direct-sum identification from target L2 makes injectivity immediate. Hook arrows correctly denote injectivity. Zero end vertical maps are the identity of the zero real vector space.

On u in U, i_C(iota_U(u))=i(u)+i0=iota_V(i(u)); on v in V, p_C(iota_V(v))=p(v)+i0=iota_W(p(v)), by target step 1.1 (also the tensor formula of target L1). The two end squares commute because both composites are zero maps. There are no reverse or diagonal maps asserted.

The diagram is explicitly conditional on the statement short exact sequence, which supplies ker i=0, im i=ker p, and im p=W; p composed with i=0 alone would not suffice. Target step 3.3 proves ker i_C=0 and im p_C=W_C, step 3.2 proves im i_C=ker p_C, and step 4.1 collects exactness. These arguments use componentwise kernel/image formulas, not the separate finite-dimensional rank/nullity clause. The rigorous proof remains unchanged and independent of the diagram.
